subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this owner-session wake routing change require live Telegram or transport proof before merge, or may maintainers accept source-level tests and CI only?
rationale: The code path is plausible and tested, but it changes user-visible session/message delivery and the PR itself says live Telegram/Mantis proof is still pending.

options.title: Require live owner-session delivery proof
options.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept source-only delivery risk
options.body: Merge with focused tests and CI only, with maintainers owning the residual risk that real transport/session delivery still drops or misroutes completion messages.

options.title: Pause for a broader delivery contract
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want one canonical completion-wake contract across background-task, exec, ACP, and subagent paths before changing this path.

recommendation.title: Require live owner-session delivery proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: The reviewed history shows recent heartbeat wake and subagent completion delivery work, and this is the clearest owner-session routing decision point among the likely owners.
